scope: Local saved halo/cover/keeper/screw/nut geometry and discrete service poses. Not continuous collision certification, ReSpeaker removal-path validation, whole-cover motion, whole-assembly static, wiring, or physical qualification.

assembly_order: Keep ReSpeaker removed during halo/keeper installation.
Lower ring from outside at -8 degrees; turn +8 to locked pose.
From inside, slide M2 nut +Y from (58.4,-12) into receiver.
Raise broad keeper from inside; fit M2x5 upward from underside.
Install unmodified ReSpeaker at its original three roof mounts.
service_order: Remove cover and ReSpeaker using its original screws.
Remove inner M2x5 and lower the keeper.
Rotate halo -8 degrees and lift from outside.
unqualified: Resin shrinkage, XY/Z fits, lug/web strength and repeated service.
Purchased M2x5 head/driver and nut dimensions; tightening torque.
LED coupling/uniformity, light leakage, acoustics and gasket fit.
Full integrated cover lift, wiring and ReSpeaker removal path.

source_objects.cover: COVER one large cap with roof ReSpeaker screw mounts

ring_insert_minus8.assembly_state: ReSpeaker removed; keeper and screw absent

ring_lock_plus8.assembly_state: ReSpeaker removed; keeper and screw absent

nut_raise_inside_at_negative_y.assembly_state: ReSpeaker removed; keeper and screw absent

nut_slide_positive_y_into_receiver.assembly_state: ReSpeaker removed; keeper and screw absent

keeper_raise_from_inside.assembly_state: ReSpeaker removed; nut seated; screw absent

screw_raise_from_inside.assembly_state: ReSpeaker removed; keeper and nut seated

sections.method: Repeated finite vertical rays on actual saved triangles in world mm; ordinary seats and capture lips use different locations and thresholds.

numerical_seat_contact_rule.scope: Cover/halo bearing interface only. Entire intersection must lie inside the known annular seat and its nominal Z plane band; raw volume is retained.

reverse_paths: Unscrew and lower screw, then lower keeper; rotate ring -8 degrees and lift. Each reverse path uses the same sampled rigid poses in reverse. ReSpeaker must be removed first.

aperture_rays.led_note: Tests opaque cover only; the transparent halo is intentionally in the light path.

sampling_scope.installed_audio: Conservative AABBs of connected native supplier bodies; not tested as one fused solid.
sampling_scope.motion_audio_state: ReSpeaker removed in every moving-part path; installed only for local static checks.

assembly_sequence: Remove ReSpeaker using its original mounts.
Lower halo at -8 degrees, then rotate +8 to lock.
Raise nut inside at negative Y; slide +Y into the receiver.
Raise keeper from inside; insert and tighten M2x5 from below.
Reinstall ReSpeaker without changing its original mounts.
